title: Israeli Drone Strikes Hit Displaced Palestinians' Tents in Al-Mawasi, Khan Younis
detail: Israeli warplanes and drones struck tents sheltering displaced Palestinians in the Al-Mawasi area west of Khan Younis on September 12, 2026, including one strike near the Shahd Rest Area. WAFA reported four civilians wounded in the Shahd Rest Area strike; separately, the Palestine Red Crescent Society said at least nine people were wounded in a strike on a tent in the wider Mawasi area, with the injured taken to Nasser Medical Complex. No fatalities were reported in either strike.

media.caption: Israeli drone strike hits tent sheltering displaced Palestinians in Al-Mawasi, west of Khan Younis, Sep 12, 2026
